overview: The biggest story is SpaceX's deal for nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum, which it says will turn Starlink Mobile into a full US phone carrier. Elon Musk and Chamath called it a very big deal, and one account reposted a jab at Verizon and AT&T. Also notable: an FT report via zerohedge that OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20B below what it had signaled, Google's first Lancet paper on its AMIE diagnostic AI, and Anthropic's new rule banning abuse of Claude. Most of Bill Ackman's and Elon's political posts were skipped.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - SpaceX agrees to buy nationwide 800 MHz spectrum; Musk calls it the last piece needed for full US phone coverage
burrytracker - FT via zerohedge: OpenAI told investors annualized revenue is near $50B, about $20B less than previously signaled
Sundar Pichai - Google's AMIE study in The Lancet: AI diagnoses matched doctors' final calls 90% of the time in a real urgent-care clinic
David Sacks - Anthropic will treat abusive behavior toward Claude as a Usage Policy violation starting November 12, 2026
Elon Musk - Grok Bot now uses Opus 5.5 when needed, runs much faster, has full X access, and connects to Shopify stores
Demis Hassabis - Google DeepMind is putting $150M into the White House and Department of Energy's Genesis Mission science initiative
Peter Steinberger - The OpenClaw Foundation won the .claw top-level domain in ICANN's 2026 round
